title: Chapter 810
text:
"Your Excellency Black Star, you're welcome to visit the school anytime."

At the dock of the spaceport, the dean brought some people to send Han Xiao off. The effect of the lecture in the morning was remarkable. Not only did the students of the school benefit, even the dean felt that he had benefited greatly. At this time, he sincerely wanted to get closer to Han Xiao.

"Hmm, let's keep in touch in the future." Han Xiao nodded and led the group into the Blacklight Stealth behind him. The spaceship started up and turned into a stream of light, shooting into the dark and vast universe along the spaceport.

With the data in hand and the lecture that he had promised the dean, he did not stay any longer and left the Tyla Civilization.

As for the influence of his association with the Tyla Civilization, he did not really care. The Tyla Civilization was a neutral civilization in the Shattered Star Ring and was very powerful. They were rarely provoked by other organizations and did not take the initiative to provoke others either. The heat of the Black Star Corps' expansion had yet to disappear, so this bit of news would not cause much of a commotion. At most, it would make the Star Cluster civilizations of the same level react a little.

However, the excited Mechanic class players on the forums surprised him. After reading the post, he realized that the public lecture had triggered the random event of high-level NPCs imparting knowledge, which gave many Mechanic class players unexpected benefits.

There were many ways for players to gain experience, and this kind of passive experience imparting by high-level NPCs was one of them. It was just that it was relatively rare. Other than luck, the chances of it happening also depended on the difference between the NPCs and the players, as well as what the NPCs were talking about. Pugilists and Mage class players were not unfamiliar with this. Pugilists could eavesdrop in some dojos and secretly learn skills, but there was a risk, and there was no guarantee that they would succeed. The main reason was to avoid farming Contribution Points. It was the same for Mages.

"I didn't expect such a coincidence. It even solidified my image as a Mechanic class teacher." Han Xiao shook his head helplessly. This was not a bad thing.

His consciousness sank into the quantum network and poked Philip.

"How's the research on that set of data?"

"It's too complicated, hum … I can't estimate the time needed to decipher it."

The positioning data of the wormhole had been handed over to Philip for calculation and analysis. A large number of experiments and measurements were required, and no one knew how long it would take to produce results.

However, Han Xiao was not in a hurry. Since the Tyla Civilization knew that he and EsGod had their eyes on this set of data, they would definitely feel that there was some secret to this set of data and would definitely organize professional scientists to study it in secret. The research speed of a Star Cluster Civilization would naturally not be slower than him and EsGod. He had a good relationship with the Tyla Civilization because he wanted to borrow their strength. If the Tyla Civilization managed to find some clues, he would also have the opportunity to enjoy the results.

He was also preparing to send the data to the Empire and borrow the Empire's technological power to decipher the secrets of the data. With such a powerful ally, it would be a waste not to use it.

…

The journey was peaceful, and the Blacklight Stealth returned to the army headquarters.

After resting for a few days, the dynasty's official order was finally issued. The Black Star Corps, Bloodshed Land, Klent, and the other Shattered Star Ring allies were to immediately head to the Flickering World through the dynasty's stargate station at the edge of the Star Field.

After preparing for so long, the dynasty was finally going to officially start the first phase of development of the Flickering World!

Han Xiao immediately issued a mobilization order.

When it was time to depart, Philip's broadcast announcement echoed throughout the entire army headquarters.

"All army members participating in the development of the Flickering World, please board the spaceship immediately. We will depart in thirty minutes! I repeat, all … "

The players could not wait to leave. They entered the spaceport and stepped onto the transport spaceships.

After the end of the secret war, the Flickering World had already become the next Main Storyline in the eyes of the players.

Exploring an unfamiliar Star Field was the grandest Main Storyline Event they had ever encountered!

The millions of players were extremely excited!

Furthermore, with the example of the (Secret Combatant) title, most of the army players accepted the Flickering World Main Storyline Mission. The number of people participating in the Flickering World Main Storyline Mission was unprecedented.

Among them, the players from the Constellation Corridor were even more excited. The players from the Shattered Star Ring had similar experiences in the past, but the number of times the Constellation Corridor players had participated in large-scale group missions could be counted on one hand. To be able to participate in such a large-scale faction activity the moment they arrived in the Shattered Star Ring, many of them felt as though they were country bumpkins entering the city.

In the past, they had only heard of the benefits of the Black Star Corps. Now that they had personally experienced it, the evaluation of the army in the hearts of the more than seven hundred thousand players increased once again.

The members of the army headquarters quickly gathered and boarded the spaceships. Under Han Xiao's order, the fleet set off and began their long journey.

A few months ago, Sylvia had already deployed all the teams. At this time, when the main fleet of the army headquarters set off, the standby teams of the many army bases in the Colton Star Cluster also set off, heading straight to their destination. According to the plan, the teams would slowly approach the main fleet midway and meet up with Han Xiao.

The number of fleets and manpower that the army had sent out this time was extremely large, taking away almost all the free troops. This was the largest operation in the history of the army.

Exploring a new Star Field, no matter how many people were sent, it would not be enough. The exploration team that was sent out this time would build a stronghold in the Flickering World and would not return for a very long time. Han Xiao was the same.

Currently, the Black Star Corps had already gained a firm foothold in the Shattered Star Ring, and their headquarters, the Colton Star Cluster, was well-guarded. Furthermore, with the support of the dynasty and Purple Crystal, as well as the protection of the identity of the Shattered Star Ring Civilization Conference, there was basically nothing to worry about.

The Flickering World was the center stage of the next version, and developing the Flickering World was the key to the next step of the army's development.

The dynasty's allies in the Shattered Star Ring were the first organizations to explore, and Han Xiao had only obtained such an advantage after many operations. This opportunity could not be missed. Only by obtaining a greater advantage and building a firm foundation could they deal with the countless organizations that would fight for territory in the future.

…

Somewhere in the Shattered Star Ring, Floating Dragon Island, Dragon Emperor Palace.

"Is that so? Black Star has already set off …"

The communicator showed the message sent by Han Xiao. Ames retracted her gaze, glanced at the Floating Dragon officers on both sides of the dragon bone throne, and softly said, "Set off.

"Let's go to Aquamarine."

…

Central Galaxy, Abyss of Stars, the mother planet of the Radiant Federation.

Radiance President Bader Alhosid put down the intelligence in his hands, looked around at the Elders in the room, and slowly said, "The Red Star Corps is finally about to open the Flickering World.

The dynasty's main focus in the future will be placed on this. It is estimated that the exploration of the Flickering World will last for hundreds of years. "

The Chief Elder tapped his walking stick and said with a hoarse voice, "The Flickering World was first discovered by our detectors. Back then, when we traded the ownership of the Flickering World to the Red Empire, we exchanged a lot of benefits. They are developing a new Star Field, and it will take a very long time for them to earn back their investment."

Back then, when they compromised with the Red Empire, it was to exchange benefits, avoid the dynasty's sharpness, and quell the Crimson Tide.

"Hmm …" Bader said calmly, "In order to develop a new Star Field, the dynasty will definitely invest a lot of manpower and resources. The Flickering World will become a quagmire that will hold the dynasty back for the next few decades. The dynasty will not be able to fight for things on other levels for a very long time. This is very beneficial to us."

The Chief Elder stroked the light crystal at the top of his walking stick and said with a deep voice, "The dynasty exchanged the ownership of the Flickering World from us and made an agreement. During the early exploration process, only the Red Empire can build stargates. Other civilizations cannot build stargates to the Flickering World without permission. Any organization that enters without permission will be treated as an enemy by the dynasty … However, the agreement is just a pile of words."

"There's no need for us to do anything," Bader said. "Those ambitious Supercluster civilizations that have always wanted to challenge our position are smart enough. They understand the standpoint of us and the Arcane Church, and they know that this is a great opportunity to profit. Not many will let go of the resources of a new Star Field. Although these chess pieces usually follow orders, as long as they see the extremely low risk and huge benefits, we don't need to do anything. They will act according to our wishes and become obedient."

After pausing for a while, Bader continued, "With so many eyes watching, the dynasty does not have the ability to monopolize the new Star Field. For political influence, trade, and other factors, the dynasty will probably open the Flickering World to the entire universe after creating a complete star map. It might be due to pressure, or it might be on their own initiative to open the Flickering World. This will allow them to obtain countless foreign labor and resources, thus recovering a large amount of the dynasty's direct military and manpower."

The Chief Elder nodded. "The dynasty has the ownership of the Star Field, but the greater the benefits, the greater the pressure they will face. Let the dynasty bear it. Only when one has something will there be a loss. We can take a step back in order to advance, and we will be able to obtain huge benefits."

Bader crossed his arms and lowered his eyes. "Since the dynasty is willing, let's increase the pressure on them."

…

Central Galaxy, Constellation Corridor, Red Empire's mother planet.

Dynasty Ruler Uranril finished reading the intelligence of the Black Star Corps and Bloodshed Land. She put down the documents in her hands and looked up. Everyone present was a top official of the dynasty.

"Your Excellency Ruler, our allies in the Shattered Star Ring were the first to explore. We will continue to invest more of the dynasty's direct troops and allies in the future. Although the Radiant Federation has compromised on the surface, they will definitely violate the agreement secretly. The Radiant Federation, the Arcane Church, and those Supercluster civilizations will definitely take action secretly."

"I know." Uranril's tone was calm. "Ever since we entered the Galaxy Calendar, the Radiant Federation has already lost its edge and is unwilling to bear the pressure. What right do they have to swallow the greatest benefits? I did not expect them to abide by the agreement from the beginning. In the next few decades, we might have a tougher time, but history will prove that those who give up on the future will be abandoned by the future."

Everyone nodded silently.

"The people causing trouble in the dark will not expose their identities. With such an opportunity, we can intimidate those Supercluster civilizations that are becoming more and more unruly."

Urranrell's eyes narrowed as she said firmly.

"Let them remember the dynasty's way of doing things!"

…

On the Fallen Ark …

Harrison flicked his tongue and woke up EsGod from his slumber.

"The Arcane Church has responded."

EsGod woke up, took a deep breath, and slowly said, "What did they say?"

"They said they do not know."

"That means they have agreed." EsGod narrowed his eyes. "Have the fleet turn around and head to the desolate universe belt near the Arcane Church. See where the temporary stargate they have prepared for me is."

…

At the edge of the Shattered Star Ring, at the border of the explored universe …

In the desolate darkness, an enormous stargate station stood in the universe, and the enormous Black Star Corps slowly approached.

This was the Red Empire's dedicated stargate station to connect to the Flickering World. Currently, this was the only way to go to the Flickering World. A large number of dynasty battleships were stationed at this station, and no one was allowed to sneak in.

After reporting their identities, the Black Star Corps fleet entered the stargate in batches and disappeared into the blue space vortex.

"It's time to explore!"

"Brothers, I'm a little excited!"

The players on the transport ships rubbed their palms in anticipation.

The main ship was about to enter the stargate. On the bridge, Hella, Fu Ding, Hardaway, and the other Black Star Guards officers subconsciously turned around and looked at the bright starry sky behind them. That was the direction of the Shattered Star Ring.

Seeing this, Han Xiao also looked back, and his heart skipped a beat.

This trip should take a long time before he returned …

It seemed like he would have to spend the ten-month EXP penalty in the Flickering World.

When he returned to the explored universe, his level should be much higher than his current level of 240.

The Evolution Cube might not be the only Universal Treasure in his hands.

Retracting his gaze, Han Xiao looked at the blue stargate vortex in front of him. On the other side of the stargate was a vast world full of opportunities.

Dong!

The next moment, the main ship entered the stargate, and the hull shook.

In an instant, only a dazzling blue light was left in his vision.
